decision.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearts of Iron IV mod dedicated small 32 by 32 pixel decision-row badge, generated at high resolution for careful downscaling.
Primary request: Create an original, restrained WWII-era strategy-game naval shipbuilding policy emblem. A clear silver-gray side-profile warship hull and one large diagonal shipyard hammer, arranged as a single bold readable symbol. The ship silhouette has only a simple bridge and one funnel; the hammer is unmistakable, large rectangular steel head above the ship, angled wooden handle. No complex rigging or fine lines.
Scene/backdrop: A compact round navy-blue/slate-blue metal badge, subdued #283b52 background, with a single simple silver steel rim. Outside the complete badge is genuinely transparent. Leave generous transparent margins around every outer edge.
Style/medium: Raster hand-painted metallic military interface icon, slightly weathered metal, crisp bold outer silhouette, directional highlights with dark contour edges, serious 1940s wartime visual vocabulary.
Composition/framing: Entire emblem centered, near square, front-facing flat badge; simplified purpose-built composition for a tiny 32px UI icon. Main ship and hammer occupy most of inner disk. Preserve space between their silhouettes. No scenery or text outside.
Color palette: navy #283b52, slate blue-gray shading, silver steel subject and rim, very restrained warm brown hammer handle.
Constraints: One badge only; alpha-transparent outside; no text, letters, numbers, numeral stages, ribbons, laurels, flags, crests, star, watermark, extra badges, modern logos, gradients fading to white, or giant picture background. Do not include a surrounding opaque rectangle.

spirit.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearts of Iron IV mod national spirit badge, ultimately displayed in a 60 by 68 pixel canvas.
Primary request: Create an original WWII-era naval shipyard mobilization emblem: one large shipyard crane clearly over an under-construction silver-gray warship hull in drydock. The crane's heavy dark steel vertical mast at left and horizontal/slightly angled beam overhead surround a prominent unfinished warship with simple bridge and two visible deck sections below. A single large hook hangs above the deck. Motif must be bold enough to remain recognizable at 60px wide.
Scene/backdrop: compact front-facing military badge with a subdued navy and slate-blue backing (#283b52), a narrow silver steel border, and a small low-relief ocean wave pattern at the bottom inside the backing. True alpha transparency outside the complete badge. No rectangular scenic background.
Style/medium: raster hand-painted metallic 1940s strategy-game interface illustration, restrained worn brushed steel, crisply defined silhouette and dark contours, realistic industrial shapes simplified into a readable emblem.
Composition/framing: vertically compact rounded shield/oval shape appropriate for national spirit art; crane arch above ship, ship fills the lower half; balanced close composition with generous transparent margins, complete metal border visible on all sides. No tall skinny crane or fine rigging. This is ship CONSTRUCTION, not a warship sailing or firing.
Color palette: dark navy #283b52, slate blue-gray highlights, silver steel ship and rim, charcoal-gray crane with subtle bronze machinery accent.
Lighting/mood: directed pale upper-left highlights on steel, dark shadow edges, serious wartime production.
Constraints: one emblem only, transparent outside, no text, numbers, stage numerals, letters, slogan, ribbon writing, flags, ideology symbols, watermark, modern logos or extra scene. No people. No explosion. No opaque surrounding rectangle.
